channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Councillor Frances Nunziata Denies Campaign Suspension Rumors
item.description: Toronto Councillor Frances Nunziata has stated that her re-election campaign is continuing, despite reports suggesting she was dropping out. She has refuted these rumors, asserting that her campaign is ongoing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
